2: The patient's presentation of a gradually enlarging mass on the wrist with positive Phalen’s maneuver and Durkan’s test, along with the imaging findings of a well-defined, encapsulated mass with biphasic contrast enhancement, is consistent with a ganglion cyst.

The location and characteristics of the mass, as well as the results of the physical examination maneuvers, could also be indicative of a giant cell tumor of the tendon sheath, although the imaging findings are more typical of a ganglion cyst.
